en: Exposition of the Section on Causes (Hetuvārādiniddesa)
"Whatever states are wholesome, are they all wholesome roots?
... "Only those three are wholesome roots; the remaining wholesome states are not wholesome roots. ... [and so on] ... "They have wholesome origins...
wholesome sources... wholesome provenances... wholesome arising... wholesome nutriment... wholesome objects... wholesome conditions... wholesome originations..."
Whatever unwholesome states there are... whatever indeterminate states there are...

whatever mental states there are—all these have mentality as their cause, mentality as their source, arise from mentality, originate from mentality, are produced by mentality, have mentality as their nutriment, have mentality as their object, are conditioned by mentality, and have mentality as their origin.
origin and production; origination, nutriment, and object.
The section on exposition is finished.
The text of the Root Pairs is finished.
